trainingDataset: synthetic-pr-data-v1 (2000 randomly-generated samples; not real repository history)
datasetDescription: Synthetic dataset generated with heuristic defect labels based on PR size, test ratio, change entropy, and author experience. Not trained on private code.
limitations: This is a demo classifier for pipeline validation only. Precision and recall are not validated against a real PR defect dataset. Do not use risk scores as proof of defects.
